== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Last Horizon]] is a massive, highly advanced starship measuring at least five hundred yards in length. Its design resembles a predatory bird mid-dive, featuring dark metal plating that appears organic and glows with magical light at its joints. Unlike standard vessels that show signs of wear or material constraints, the interior of this ship is characterized by an unnatural level of perfection. The vessel possesses significant power and can act as a combatant, capable of piercing enemy defenses like a blade or utilizing green energy weapons to disable engines. It is operated by a Captain who also serves as a caster and possesses the ability to deploy shields. The ship is capable of awakening, an event that grants it immense strength to confront major threats. It has been observed positioned at the edge of the [[Dornoth system]] and has engaged in combat within the [[Fathom system]], where it faced planetary defenses and various fleets. The ship's internal systems may eventually be integrated into a larger network involving planets and [[World Spirits]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Fathom is a moon and the human home world that serves as the capital of the [[Galactic Union]]. Often called the Heart of the Galaxy, this ancient center of culture and economy is home to twelve sprawling megacities and maintains a Planetary Defense [[Force]]. The world functions as a [[World Spirit]] with an avatar and projection, serving as the concentrated heart of [[Solstice]]'s power. While [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] once attempted to track [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]] to this location, [[Benri Vallenar|Benri]] eventually docked there after receiving a call that likely originated from the planet. During an attack by the narrator's side, the world faced defenders and events that left [[Benri Vallenar]] horrified.}}
